reason: The first RGB epoch reduces hard-negative FP but standalone .75 recall declines. A standalone branch filter could discard a checkpoint that retains complete-system recall after skeleton fusion and priors. Compare all scheduled epochs jointly on validation under the unchanged full-system retention constraints.
primary_objective: Minimize equal-domain human other FPR, subject to old supported-class recalls >=production baseline - .05 and new positive macro recall >=production baseline - .10. Then macroF1, positive TP, nearest original parameters, adapted over original, earlier epoch.
input: Only canonical old validation and human-reviewed new validation; no pseudo truth.
test_lock: selection-lock.json is written before evaluate_selected.py scores any test labels.
